page.title: Universal QR Scan Demo
page.desc: A pure-browser WebRTC camera QR scanning component, fully decoupled from business logic and reusable on any page.

tip.label: Tip:
tip.body: HTTPS is required in production; camera access works on localhost during local development; compatible with Chrome / Edge / Safari on mobile and desktop.

overlay.hint: Place the QR code inside the frame to scan
